verdict.rationale: Cyril Amarchand Mangaldas is a law firm offering professional legal services, not a software platform that hosts user data, so self-service export of all data in open formats is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows the firm ships any data-hosting product or export capability that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
